column1: # docs/globals-client-ledger.tsv -- one row per piece of STATIC STORAGE STATE on
# the CLIENT link line, and what is to become of it. The client's half of
# plan_globals.md step G0; the server's is docs/globals-ledger.tsv, and the two
# are separate files so that the lanes ruling each side never rewrite the
# Same schema, same key, same gate as the server ledger. `tools/globals-census
# gate --side client` fails in BOTH directions: a symbol with no row, and a row
# whose symbol is no longer there. RECONCILE with `reseed --side client
# --write`, which carries every ruling forward; never regenerate.
# THE KEY IS (home, mangled). `home` is the object for a LOCAL symbol and
# empty for a folded GLOBAL/WEAK/UNIQUE one; `mangled` is the symbol table's
# name. See the server ledger's header for why neither can be the demangled
# THE CLIENT IS NOT SHAPED LIKE THE SERVER, measured at 281d19e1b (debug):
#   guard variables and 912 vec2/vec4 header copies = 2,243 object level ->
#   1,966 LINK LEVEL. The server's link level is 469.
#   1,349 of the 1,966 rows (69%) are in STOCK code -- game/client alone is
#   1,215 -- where the server's stock game/server and game/shared rows are
#   zero. Most of the client's state is not the port's yet; it is the stock
#   client the port has not replaced. That is why most rows are UNRULED: the
#   file they live in has no port ruling to rule them against.
#   The server has ONE root (s_gameShellDll). The client has FOUR objects of
#   that shape -- g_ShellClientDLL, g_Prediction and two EXPOSE_SINGLE_INTERFACE
#   singletons -- each returned by CreateInterface to a module found by
#   grepping the shipped binaries for its version string (engine.so x3,
#   GameUI.so x1). There is no single client root today; one would have to be
#   built, and the other three become its members.
# THE RECONCILIATION, a partition whose residue must be empty (release, the
#   instrument 2  client.so mutable 2780 = 1666 from link-line objects
#                 + 1100 from the 10 archives (nm over the .a files on disk)
#   The archive term is 1,100 here against the server's 125 (same command,
#   --side server, same tip). The client links four archives the server
#   does not -- vgui_controls, matsys_controls, bitmap, vtf -- and their
#   the .so but in no link-line object. They are counted, not ledgered --
#   this ledger is the link line's.
#   Release names 0 symbols this debug-keyed ledger lacks (gate --config
# DISPOSITIONS as the server ledger. What was derived here, and on what:
#   DEAD     251  the debug linker drops it. Re-derivable at any tip.
#                 each with its evidence in the reason column and its mechanism
#                 pinned by check_floor_subject(); 22 Steam SDK accessor cells
#   UNRULED 1682  everything else. An admission, not a ruling.
# CONST, MANAGED and MEMBER are ZERO on purpose. Each needs somebody to read
# the code and name a writer, a managed home or an engine consumer, and a
# disposition with no evidence is worse than UNRULED because it looks settled.
# WHAT WOULD SETTLE THE UNRULED ROWS, by class:
#   stock game/client, game/shared, public/*  the client port replacing the
#       file; rows then leave with it, or move to the shim and get ruled there.
#       [ConVar] vs native), as plan_shim Phase 5 did for the server.
#   63 InterfaceReg nodes                     grep the shipped modules for the
#       string each registers (material proxies by NAME: the .vmt text, not
#   the rest of the shim's rows               read per row: a writer besides
#       the initialiser (CONST), a managed home (MANAGED), or an engine
#       consumer plus a lifetime tier on a client root (MEMBER).
